name: stratosort-stack
description: StratoSort Stack - Local AI Document Organizer. Privacy-focused document organization using in-process AI (node-llama-cpp + Orama). No required external services: inference, embeddings, and search run on-device.

scripts.dev: node scripts/check-running-instance.js && npm run clean && npm run build:main:dev && npm run build:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron . --enable-logging
scripts.build: npx rimraf dist && npm run build:main && cross-env NODE_ENV=production webpack --mode=production && node scripts/copy-assets-to-dist.js --strict && node scripts/sync-installer-license.js && node scripts/verify-splash-csp-hash.js
scripts.generate:assets: npm run generate:icons && npm run generate:nsis
scripts.package: npx rimraf dist && npm run build && npm run generate:nsis && npm run setup:vision-runtime && npm run setup:vision-runtime:check && npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime && npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime:check && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime:check && electron-builder build --publish never
scripts.start: npm run build:main:dev && npm run build:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron . --enable-logging
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:stress
scripts.test:soak: cross-env SOAK=1 SOAK_MINUTES=12 npx playwright test test/e2e/soak.spec.js --timeout=1200000
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run generate:nsis && npm run setup:vision-runtime && npm run setup:vision-runtime:check && npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime && npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime:check && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime:check && electron-builder --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run generate:nsis && npm run setup:vision-runtime && npm run setup:vision-runtime:check && npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime && npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime:check && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime:check && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:win:verify: npm run verify:installed-electron && npm run build && npm run generate:nsis && npm run setup:vision-runtime && npm run setup:vision-runtime:check && npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime && npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime:check && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime:check && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.verify.json
scripts.dist:mac: npm run dist:mac:arm64 && npm run dist:mac:x64 && npm run rebuild
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run generate:branding-if-source && npm run build && cross-env STRATOSORT_VISION_RUNTIME_ARCH=arm64 npm run setup:vision-runtime && npm run setup:vision-runtime:check && cross-env STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_PLATFORM=darwin STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_ARCH=arm64 npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime && cross-env STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_PLATFORM=darwin STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_ARCH=arm64 npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime:check && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime:check && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run generate:branding-if-source && npm run build && cross-env STRATOSORT_VISION_RUNTIME_ARCH=x64 npm run setup:vision-runtime && npm run setup:vision-runtime:check && cross-env STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_PLATFORM=darwin STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_ARCH=x64 npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime && cross-env STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_PLATFORM=darwin STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_ARCH=x64 npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime:check && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime:check && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run setup:vision-runtime && npm run setup:vision-runtime:check && npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime && npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime:check && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime:check && electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:linux:x64: npm run build && cross-env STRATOSORT_VISION_RUNTIME_ARCH=x64 npm run setup:vision-runtime && npm run setup:vision-runtime:check && cross-env STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_PLATFORM=linux STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_ARCH=x64 npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime && cross-env STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_PLATFORM=linux STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_ARCH=x64 npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime:check && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime:check && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: npm run build && cross-env STRATOSORT_VISION_RUNTIME_ARCH=arm64 npm run setup:vision-runtime && npm run setup:vision-runtime:check && cross-env STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_PLATFORM=linux STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_ARCH=arm64 npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime && cross-env STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_PLATFORM=linux STRATOSORT_FFMPEG_RUNTIME_ARCH=arm64 npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime:check && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime:check && electron-builder --linux --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.dist:win:arm64: npm run build && npm run generate:nsis && cross-env STRATOSORT_VISION_RUNTIME_ARCH=arm64 npm run setup:vision-runtime && npm run setup:vision-runtime:check && cross-env SKIP_FFMPEG_RUNTIME=true npm run setup:ffmpeg-runtime && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime && npm run setup:tessdata-runtime:check && electron-builder --win nsis --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.win-arm64.json
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:mac && npm run dist:win && npm run dist:linux
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:js && npm run audit:production && npm run audit:bundled && npm run compliance:commercial:verify && git diff --exit-code -- docs/commercial-use-inventory.json && npm run test:coverage && npm run generate:channels:check && npm run verify:ipc-handlers && npm run verify:ipc-handler-schemas && npm run verify:ipc-contracts && npm run verify:ipc-enforcement && npm run verify:ipc-event-schemas && npm run verify:mcp-contracts && npm run verify:ai-provider-contracts && npm run verify:analysis-routing && npm run verify:electron-fuses-config && npm run verify:env-docs && npm run verify:checkjs-ratchet && npm run verify:version-tag && npm run knip:files && npm run build
scripts.local:gate: npm run verify:installed-electron && npm run ci && npm run verify:native-modules
scripts.test:critical-path: npx jest --config test/jest.config.js test/analysis-ipc-handlers.test.js test/analysisSlice.test.js test/useOrganization.test.js test/batchOrganizeHandler.test.js test/OrganizationSuggestionServiceCore.migration.test.js test/semanticIpc.search.test.js test/components/UnifiedSearchModal.test.js --runInBand --no-coverage
